title: Game state machine — config/state-machine.json
description: The single authoritative game state machine: the exact 23 canonical states from CONVENTIONS §4.4, all transitions with guards, entry/exit actions, recovery rules, terminal states, invalid-transition policy, and the presentation (animation) and audio maps. UI overlays (menus, paytable) are NOT states here. Server-owned round states: round_requested → outcome_received → outcome_committed → … → round_complete.

states.description: Exactly the 23 canonical states — no additions, removals, or renames.

transitions.description: Every legal state transition. Anything not listed is illegal and handled per invalidTransitionPolicy.

event.description: snake_case event that fires this transition, e.g. spin_pressed, outcome_committed, presentation_done.

guards.description: Ids of guards (see guards[]) that must ALL pass for the transition to fire. Empty array = unconditional.
Named boolean predicates evaluated against committed round state (never against a predicted outcome).

id.description: snake_case guard id referenced from transitions[].guards.

description.description: What this guard checks, e.g. 'scatterCount >= 3 in committed manifest'.

actions.description: Named side effects bound to state entry and/or exit. Actions are presentation/bookkeeping only; they never alter the committed outcome.

description.description: What the action does, e.g. 'lock spin button', 'persist resume pointer'.

onEntryOf.description: State whose entry runs this action.

onExitOf.description: State whose exit runs this action.

recoveryRules.description: Per-state recovery behavior after disconnect/reload. Recovery always replays the committed manifest from resumePointer; it never re-randomizes.

state.description: State the client was in when interrupted.

resumable.description: Whether an interrupted session in this state resumes mid-round (true) or restarts at ready with the round settled server-side (false).

resumeTo.description: State the client enters after recovery completes (commonly recovering → this).

notes.description: How recovery behaves here, e.g. 'seek presentation to resumePointer step instantly'.

terminalStates.description: States with no outgoing transitions in the round lifecycle (typically round_complete; error is terminal until operator/session recovery).

invalidTransitionPolicy.description: What the engine does when an event has no legal transition from the current state: ignore silently, enter error, or enter recovering and re-fetch the committed manifest.

presentationMap.description: State → animation event ids played while in that state. Keys must be canonical state names; every id must exist in config/animation-events.json.

audioMap.description: State → audio event ids (music states and sfx) active in that state. Keys must be canonical state names; every id must exist in config/audio-events.json. Music must cover base plus all three feature tiers.

stateName.description: One of the 23 canonical game states (CONVENTIONS §4.4).

animEventId.description: Animation event id in dot notation, e.g. anim.feature.enter.

audioEventId.description: Audio event id: music.<state>, sfx.<context>.<name>, amb.<name>, or ui.<name>.
